# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deliberate removals (task 9.7, decision D9) — re-decide on every sync
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# These five files are `DU`: the fork deleted them while upstream modified
# them. "Keep our deletion" is a standing decision, so it is written down
# rather than re-derived. scripts/sync_report.py prints this list on every
# conflicted sync so an operator re-confirms it instead of re-applying it.
#
# README.md, docs/zh/README.md, docs/zh/README-Hant.md, docs/ja/README.md
#   The fork ships no READMEs at all (upstream 25 -> fork 0): the product name,
#   install story and screenshots in upstream's READMEs describe a different
#   build. Upstream edits to them are therefore *not* carried across; the
#   fork's user-facing docs live in doc/ and webhelp/. Re-decide if the fork
#   ever needs an upstream-style README (then take upstream's file and edit it,
#   do not resurrect the deletion).
#
# desktop/src/renderer/src/components/PermissionSelector.tsx
#   Replaced by the RBAC execution-permission model (permission set comes from
#   the tenant role and its resource grants, not a local selector).
#   tests/test_execution_permission_ui.cjs asserts the component and its toggle
#   are absent, so re-adding one would fail that test rather than silently
#   reintroduce a second authorization path. Re-decide if the desktop client
#   ever needs to *display* (not choose) effective permissions.
